verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document concurrency limits, parallel session handling, batch endpoints, or throughput guarantees for running many scraping sessions at once. The rotating proxy pool, self-hostable Docker image, and S3 caching are adjacent building blocks and do not establish concurrent scraping at scale. A community comment notes the site does not mention API limits, which is an open question rather than support.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can spin up many concurrent scraping sessions to gather data at scale
